title: DG1 - Dependency
claim: Every non-root layer in a valid derivation depends on at least one prior layer or explicitly declared root.
assumptions: A derived layer cannot be intelligible without prerequisite structure.
negative_guards: Dependency is a grammar rule, not a theology claim.
Root layers must be declared rather than hidden.
kill_conditions: A non-root derivation step is valid while requiring no prior structure and no declared root.
The dependency relation cannot be represented without circular ambiguity.

ledger.meaning: Source claim ingested into Lane 4 ledger.
